items.text: Simplest bull case for Ravens pass game with Jacoby Brissett: less efficiency mitigated by more volume. Lamar had 35+ pass attempts in only 15% of career starts vs Brissett 47%; also fewer scrambles.
items.why: Brissett career volume profile creates more pass attempts than Lamar efficiency/scramble style.
items.implication: Ravens pass catchers (Flowers, Andrews, Henry receiving) see elevated opportunity ROS while Lamar out.
items.opportunity: Higher dropback volume, fewer designed runs/scrambles for QB.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love placed on IR (react in sit/start/waivers context); high-ankle, 4-5 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain Week 8; IR designation.
items.implication: ARI RB committee opens; Allgeier/others elevated 4+ weeks.

items.text: BAL loses Lamar Jackson, likely for the season (thumb injury, IR/surgery). Huntley also season-ending toe. Brissett acquired but not for TNF; Fagnano starts short-term.
items.why: Thumb injury on first snap Week 8 return; surgery expected, IR.
items.implication: Major downgrade Ravens offense short-term; Brissett elevates pass volume later.

items.text: Seattle’s backfield with Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returns: “It’s gonna be like Charbonnet/Walker expect with I guess worse versions of the players.”
items.why: Both returning; expected split similar to prior Walker/Charbonnet but diminished talent.
items.implication: Neither is clear lead; handcuff/committee plays, lower individual ceilings.
items.opportunity: Shared carries/snaps; monitor practice for split.

items.text: Nick Bosa returns to practice. While RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) and WR Mike Evans won’t go today.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri; risk of limited or out for Week 9.

items.text: AJ Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue.
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated; Hollins return practice adds competition/volatility.
items.opportunity: Targets to other NE pass catchers.

items.text: Wheels completely fall off for IND, Jonathan Taylor saga continues.
items.why: Ongoing team/role issues post recent struggles.
items.implication: Uncertainty around JT usage/role; monitor IND offense collapse.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts made appearance Wednesday at practice facility, first time some players seen him since IR for blood clots in lungs.
items.why: Blood clots IR; positive step seeing teammates.
items.implication: No imminent return; monitor recovery timeline.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs is not anticipating missing more time despite additional allegations.
items.implication: Full go for GB backfield; no downgrade.

items.text: Rams open window for TE Terrance Ferguson (practice today). Last full game (Wk2, Nacua out): 42% slot/wide, 70% routes (23/33), 29% target share with Adams playing.
items.why: Prior high route/target share in Nacua absence shows TE/WR hybrid upside.
items.implication: Potential TE streamer/flex if role sticks; monitors Nacua/Adams target cannibalization.

items.text: Up in pace: DAL @ IND. Slow paced slogs: HOU @ LAC. Full Week 9 Snaps & Pace notes.
items.why: DAL fast neutral pace + IND potential uptick vs weak D; high total.
items.implication: Volume boost for DAL-IND pass/rush skill players.

items.text: KEEPING IT OPEN on Ladd McConkey this week as a WR3. Let’s not get carried away.
items.why: Viable WR3 floor despite recent/foot notes; not overvaluing.

items.text: Did Jerry Jones say George Pickens needs the ball more? Yes. Does that change anything for fantasy? Not really.
items.why: Owner comment but no material scheme/role shift expected.
items.implication: No upgrade from talk alone; stick to usage trends.
items.conflict: Coach/owner comments vs actual snap/target data.

items.text: Trevor Lawrence only QB9 in FPPG but would be far higher if Jags not playing so well (conservative 4th quarter). Passing by quarter shows early volume/TDs.
items.why: Game script suppresses late volume; underlying pass attempts strong early.
items.implication: Positive regression if Jags trail more; stackable with WRs.
